space.$description: Spacing: Tailwind v4's 4px rhythm, adopted as-is. v1's ladder was 2/4/6/8/11/14/16/20/24 and its own comment insisted the odd steps were deliberate — that is what a hand-built scale looks like after two years of one-off adjustments. Ten control paddings (pad-btn, pad-field, pad-chip, pad-seg-btn, pad-kbd, …) are gone with it: shadcn components own their own padding, and re-specifying it here is how a second design system starts.

gap-row.$description: Between a row's glyph, its body and its actions.

pad-row-y.$description: LOAD-BEARING. ROW_PAD_V in the virtualiser is 2 × this. If it changes, the row-height model changes with it or rows overlap (INV-5).

pad-row.$description: CSS shorthand composed from the two scalars above so the virtualiser and the stylesheet cannot drift.

pad-empty.$description: Inset around an empty / error / offline state.
